title: Loading / navigation seems slow
description:
This will be frustrating in its lack of specifics. But I generally perceive that the manual sites are "slow". To be more specific, the one I only interact with much is the [Writing R Extensions](https://rstudio.github.io/r-manuals/r-exts/). I don't really know why that would be :thinking: But I've noticed it enough times, over a reasonably long time period, that I wanted to raise it.

We generally use GitHub Pages for pkgdown sites and I haven't noticed similar slowness there. So I'm not sure if there's any point in considering deployment to, say, Netlify.

Can those of you with more knowledge of the project speculate if there's anything about its structure that might explain the slowness? Of course, it's possible that I'm just getting unlucky.

title: The "double backtick problem"
description: Example `.texi` input: ``` ... which can be found in the @file{src/library/@var{pkg}/man} directories ... ``` https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/a505a59a02f445e4918777a585270faee97c42e8/doc/manual/R-exts.texi#L6606 Leads to this in the official `.html` manual: ``` html ... which can be found in the src/library/pkg/man directories ... ``` But like this in the `.html` from the Quarto-ized manual: ``` html ... which can be found in the src/library/``pkg/man directories ... ``` which looks like this: ![Screen Shot 2022-10-27 at 11 45 48 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/599454/198373282-f8f5f7c8-3c45-4a8a-81fd-3028a138167d.png) --- Example `.texi` input: ``` \name@{@var{name}@} ``` https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/a505a59a02f445e4918777a585270faee97c42e8/doc/manual/R-exts.texi#L6727 Leads to this in the official `.html` manual: ``` html \name{name} ``` But like this in the `.html` from the Quarto-ized manual: ``` html \name{``name} ``` which looks like this: ![Screen Shot 2022-10-27 at 11 45 57 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/599454/198373352-7dfb8f33-0897-4e21-aa90-13861f600079.png)

title: R-internals chapter on Internals vs Primitives isn't rendering
description:
Hi team!

Great stuff on the rendered version of the R manuals.

The chapter on internals vs primitives is currently staying an md file instead of getting converted html. My guess is that it has something to do with the unusual chapter name that has periods.
https://github.com/rstudio/r-manuals/blob/gh-pages/r-ints/_002eInternal-vs-_002ePrimitive.md

Thanks!
